# HttpApi

[API index](../index.md)

HTTP requests owned by the current script instance.

**@keywords**

http, fetch, request, asynchronous

## fetch

```typescript
fetch(url: string): Promise<Response>;
```

Send GET to an absolute ASCII or percent-encoded HTTP(S) URL. HTTP error statuses return a
Response; invalid arguments or transport failure reject with TypeError. Options are not
supported. Closing the script aborts its pending requests.

**@keywords**

http, catalog, json, prices, asynchronous
